scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @odin/api" "npm run dev -w @odin/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @odin/api && npm run build -w @odin/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run start:prod -w @odin/api" "npm run start -w @odin/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @odin/api && npm run lint -w @odin/web
